name: taxme-mcp
description: MCP server for the Canton of Bern tax portal TaxMe / BE-Login — read AND fill tax returns (open, navigate, set fields, results, gated submit) via SwissID/AGOV browser automation, with cached sessions (storageState) that survive restarts
author: sapn95

scripts.gate: node --check index.js && npm run lint && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/hygiene.mjs && npm run coverage
scripts.prepublishOnly: node --check index.js && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/hygiene.mjs
